status.principle: Declares Exp6197 itself terminal only after fixture replay, checks, and checksum validation finish.

protected_artifact_mutation_count.principle: Bare zero proves fixture replay did not rewrite historical artifacts.

classifier_module_and_hash.principle: Names and hashes the shared classifier module used for this contract.

focused_test_commands.principle: Lists focused unit, coverage, roadmap-schema, spec-coverage, and E2E-plan commands.

focused_test_exit_codes.principle: Stores focused command exit codes so unrun or failed checks cannot look clean.

full_suite_command_and_classified_exit_c.principle: Separates global-suite health from focused classifier correctness.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares deterministic artifact replay, not model inference or benchmark measurement.

field_provenance.principle: Ties every required field to fixtures, classifier constants, command receipts, or local hashes.

field_principles.principle: Keeps the reason for every required field adjacent to the emitted value.

duration_s.principle: Reports real wall time for the deterministic replay without padding.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content-addresses the report after blanking duration and the checksum field.

honest_verdict.principle: Uses a terminal prefix and states the bootstrap/nonterminal preservation result.
